notes.title: Royal Quest Online Creators Program
notes.notes:
[p]If you are professionally engaged in gaming broadcasts, create reviews, release video guides, or just stream for friends, you can take part in the Royal Quest Online Creators Program and start making cool content with us.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962300/Royal_Quest_Online/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Join the Program, create video content about Royal Quest Online, earn rewards — and get acess to the prizes for giveaways among your subscribers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/350296b582fee376310a074bcbb935a0fe0cd9f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rules:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]comply with the game rules and the rules of the platform on which you run your channel ([url="https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/broadcasting-guidelines?language=en_US"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/creators/how-things-work/policies-guidelines/"]YouTube[/url], etc.);[/p][/*][*][p]you must not have any fake engagement on your channel;[/p][/*][*][p]treat others with respect in the game, on the official Royal Quest platforms and on your own channel;[/p][/*][*][p]send monthly reports on broadcasts and videos to the curator of the Creator Program.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The goal of the Creators Program is to support active players who create interesting content dedicated to the game, gameplay tactics and events. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Participation in the Program does not imply the creation of advertising content.[/b] Content aimed at attracting attention to a specific item (game) or promoting the game in the market may be recognized as advertising.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Creator Program Levels[/b][/h2][p]Our Program has three levels. The higher your Creator Level, the higher the reward for each video, stream, or vertical short.[/p][p]
We don’t limit your format: create full-length videos, cut them into shorts, then go live with your audience to discuss game updates or simply chill while completing quests and clearing dungeons.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 1[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Short – 150 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Stream – 350 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Video – 500 Reales[/p][/*][/list][p]Maximum monthly reward for Level 1 Creators: [b]3,000 Reales.[/b][/p][p]You can also raffle off game items worth up to 2,500 Reais among your subscribers every month in addition to a personal reward.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 2[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Short – 300 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Stream – 450 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Video – 750 Reales[/p][/*][/list][p]Maximum monthly reward for Level 2 Creators: [b]5,000 Reales[/b][/p][p]You can also raffle off in-game items worth up to 5,000 Reais among your subscribers every month in addition to a personal reward.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 3[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Short – 500 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Stream – 750 Reales[/p][/*][*][p]Video – 1,250 Reales[/p][/*][/list][p]Maximum monthly reward for Level 3 Creators: 10,000 Reales[/p][p]You can also raffle off in-game items worth up to 10,000 Reais among your subscribers every month in addition to a personal reward.[/p][p][/p][p]Royal Quest Online blogs, player guides, and art pieces will still be evaluated separately.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rewards for Subscribers and How to Conduct Giveaways[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Periodically, various gift boxes, new sets of Tranzamples and other in-game valuables appear in the game store.[/p][p][/p][p]Creators of the Creators Program can monthly raffle any items [b]currently available in the in-game store [/b]among their subscribers. Their total value must not exceed the budget available to them within the Program.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/010d0c5141b43b043b4b4c7fd207b5f3d1a55b07.png"][/img][/p][p]Before hosting a giveaway, creators must agree with the Program curator on the contest rules, the number of winners and the prizes.[/p][p][/p][p]The format of the giveaway can include: quizzes, random winner determination, contests and other competition formats that can be evaluated based on predefined criteria.[/p][p][/p][p]After a giveaway, creators collect the contact details (server, nickname) from the winning players and forward them to the Creator Program curator.[/p][p][/p][p]Rewards for the Creator's subscribers are credited within 7 days after the Creator has provided the winners' data to the Creator Program curator. The game's administration is responsible for crediting the rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Communication[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The official [url="https://discord.gg/VPThDvmhJT"]Royal Quest Online Discord server[/url] is used for communicating with the participants. Upon separate request, we can communicate on Telegram; however, all important news regarding the Creators Program will be published exclusively on Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Receiving the Royal Creator role on our Discord server informs other community members about the streamer's entry into the Creator Program.[/p][p][/p][p]Exclusion from the Program implies the removal of this role.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]How to Join the Creators Program?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]If you are 18 years old or older, you can contact the community manager through private messages on Discord and submit an application.[/p][/*][*][p]You will need to provide a link to your channel, as well as your gaming data (main character nickname, server, level, class).[/p][/*][*][p]To become a Royal Quest Online Creator, your channel's metrics must meet at least the requirements for the first participation level of the Program (subscribers + views). For more information, please contact ourcommunity manager or program curator.[/p][/*][*][p]In case your participation is approved, you will receive a special role in Discord and access to the special category—Creators Hub. There you can agree on your giveaways, submit your monthly statistics, communicate with other creators and find unique materials about the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/a008ae8a03fc1a2578d3ea8cbe280b110e5c8d3e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Regular Reporting and Rewards[/b][/h2][p]
At the beginning of each month, creators submit their activity statistics for the previous month to the Royal Quest Online team through a special feedback form.[/p][p][/p][p]After the project team has received and analyzed the statistics, those creators, who have met the Program's conditions, will receive the rewards on their personal game accounts based on the levels they have achieved.[/p][p][/p][p]You can change the game account to which the reward is credited upon a separate agreement with the team.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Exclusion from the Creators Program[/b][/h2][p]A participant can be excluded from the Program in case of violation of the terms and/or failure to meet the requirements of the Crators Program.[/p][p][/p][p]In case of violations by a participant of the Creators Program, the administration reserves the right to exclude them from the Program without monthly rewards and without providing any prizes for giveaways.[/p][p][/p][p]Violations include fraud in the form of awarding participants of giveaways in collusion, misleading participants of giveaways or negligent conduct in the organization of giveaways.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Royal Chronicles
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, friends![/b][/h3][p]Today, we want to share some interim results of the Cardigan's Mystery and talk about our plans. Let’s get started![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Key Event[/b][/h3][p]At the end of August, an updated version of the Cardigan's Mystery launched. This year, our team developed a new activity where players must hide from the dangerous Soul Keeper in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth. Sure thing, there’s a reward![/p][p]The event started off with a few hiccups: in the first days when the Mystery launched, there were issues related to daily quests. The developers took action to fix the bug and compensated for the missed Questles and rewards from the Minotaur’s Labyrinth quest.[/p][p]We’re also receiving feedback from our players about issues with the Groppy Metal Detector and the Sack of Powder. If you encounter this issue:[/p][p]— Try returning to the character selection menu and re-entering the game.[/p][p]— To reduce the chances of an issue to appear, complete and claim the reward for the quests [b]only[/b] if you have successfully finished both.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/91d19245b1a8a6912d93abc460f27b85267de9d2.png"][/img][/p][h3]A few important reminders:[/h3][p]— Event consumables, namely: Alchemical Lockpicks, Otherland Coins and Mechanic's Ominous Seals will be removed from the game when the event ends. Make sure to use them in time![/p][p]— Remember that you need to claim your Seasonal Adventure rewards manually and on time to avoid losing them. [/p][p]— And, on a happy note, the annual Cardigan's Mystery event has been extended until September 30![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What has the Card of the Dark Carabus ever done to you?![/b][/h3][p]We have closely reviewed your feedback on the balance changes to the Seals and the Card of the Dark Carabus. Thank you for sharing with us![/p][p]We want to make it clear: these current changes are an essential first step in rebalancing the game. We deliberately started with elements that objectively required immediate attention.[/p][p]This is just the beginning of a long journey. Our shared goal is to create a truly balanced and fair gameplay experience.[/p][p]Stay tuned for updates and please keep sharing your thoughts. Your feedback is a key part of this process.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]You’ve previously asked us several questions:[/b][/h3][p][b]What can we expect in the near future?[/b][/p][p]— At the end of the month, we’re planning another round of rebalancing (we’ll share details in a separate post). We’re also implementing a promo code system. All players will definitely receive gift codes on the day when the feature goes live! And much more, which we’ll reveal in future notes.[/p][p][b]Are there plans for in-game interactions with players through events? (Hide and seek, fighting evil bosses, etc.)[/b] [/p][p]~ We are working on game activities that the community will enjoy. Stay tuned![/p][p][b]When will repairs to the defensive walls in Varlone be finished?[/b]
~ The military engineers are not sure. But we did spot some new Ashkalot construction in Varlone. What do you think it is?[/p][p][b]There’s a “Have an idea!” section on the Royal Quest fan forum. Does the RQ team read it? Maybe some ideas have already been borrowed from there?[/b]
~ Absolutely, and not only from there. Ideas, as well as feedback, are read and processed by the team and, if possible and appropriate, are implemented.[/p][p][b]Will there be unicorns in the game? Rumor has it they make any game 20% cooler.[/b]
~ In the magical world of Aura, nothing is impossible![/p][hr][/hr][p]And with that, this devblog episode comes to a close. Share your impressions, feelings and questions![/p][p][i]See you in Royal Quest![/i][/p]

[/i][/b][i]

[/b]• The free track of the Seasonal Adventure is available to all heroes participating in the event.

notes.title: ✨ Dual Wielding — Twice the Flash, Twice the Damage!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Royal Quest Online dev team is still working hard on improving different game aspects. Today, we’re gonna talk about what our awesome animation artists have been up to 😎🗡️.[/b]

The Thief subclass is the only hero in Aura who can fight with a weapon in each hand — and we're spicing things up with some brand-new attack animations! Now your characters can really show off when you gear them up with a pair of axes 💥.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/376ccfe160d03eac0acc63c8a76831d17a7a2a4b.gif"][/img]
We spoke with the team to find out how these new character moves come to life:

[i]"The base for the new animations comes from reference video footage so we can nail the motion and overall flow. Then it’s time for stylization and applying artistic techniques."

[/i]All animations are done entirely by hand, frame by frame, no motion capture here. Every swing and spin are the result of serious dedication and attention to detail 🎨💪.[i]

[/i]But how do you keep everything smooth when the characters never stop moving?

[i]"Animators build in special ‘transition poses’ so the character can flow naturally from one move to another. Then technical artists polish and set up extra transitions inside the game engine."



[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/7f8bf6ded828d41449ce713e2fd0334ba92cd007.gif"][/img]Of course, this isn’t all that Royal Quest Online dev team is working on—we’ll keep sharing more updates with time. 

[b]Stay tuned! ⚔️🌀[/b][i]

notes.title: High-society Friends
notes.notes:
In a world where looks can be just as important as armor rating, there's "Bordeaux"—a fashion statement born from elegance and prestige. Designed by our art team as attire fit for royal events, this outfit was created for those rare moments: whether it be dazzling at a kingdom-wide celebration or attending the court of King Roland himself. The inspiration came from Baxter—the epitome of impeccable taste in Royal Quest and Aura’s one and only style icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/49ed72394d3f31c42411ceafc33e1d3be14f718d.png[/img]

The creative process started with bold silhouettes, blending timeless elegance with a more relaxed, flowing aesthetic. Through trial and error, the artists stumbled upon a striking contrast: a dark, brooding male silhouette paired with a delicate, playful feminine design. Follow the visual journey in the concept art, from sharp lines and dramatic shapes to the final, softer color scheme of ivory, gold, and deep burgundy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/5e081e26c0d47cc469bb1d5f62bf4da5ac9cb150.png[/img]

Countless drafts were tested, all to nail that elusive "effortless style". Velvet trims, intricate stitching, delicate belts, and a daringly asymmetrical skirt, every element was chosen to craft the one outfit heroes would save for their most unforgettable adventures.

notes.notes:
[h3]🎪 Sky Fair Event: Holyday Guide[/h3]

Hey friend, from April 10th to April 29th, get ready for a massive event—The Sky Fair in Royal Quest! In this guide, we’ll quickly break down how you can make the most of the event and snag as many rewards as possible.

[h3]How can I join the event?  [/h3]

·    Find "Mysterious Scroll" in your quest list and turn it in to Omnis at the fountain in Varlone.

·    Complete the Omnis quest chain with a Level 20+ hero. Don't forget to pick a specialization!

[h3]How do I get to the Sky Fair?[/h3]

Once you’ve completed the Omnis quest chain, he'll teleport you directly to the Sky Fair location.

[h3]What can I do at the Sky Fair?[/h3]

Complete Baxter's quest to get a special event item and unlock the "Unbridled Fun" Seasonal Adventure.

[h3]What is "Unbridled Fun"?[/h3]

It’s a unique mechanic with two progress bars: free and premium. The free part of Seasonal Adventure is available to all heroes who have met the mentioned conditions. As for the premium part, there are 4 ways to unlock it:

1. Automatically unlock it for free if you have the "Mysterious Ancient Scroll" item from Saint Vallen’s Day;
2. Purchase access for 2,990 Reales (in-game currency) through the Seasonal Adventure window;
3. Purchase the "Unbridled Fun: Elite Access" item from the Store for 2,990 Reales (can be sold at the auction house).
4. Purchase "Unbridled Fun: Elite Access" using in-game gold from other players at the auction house.

[h3]What rewards can I get for completing "Unbridled Fun"?[/h3]

For completing Seasonal Adventure’s Free Version, you'll earn over 50 rewards including: Mechanosaur, Rune of Preservation, Arconite Sealing Wax, Card of Fire and much more!
2. In Seasonal Adventure’s Premium Version, you'll get all the rewards from the free version plus: Aurora (pet), "Bordeaux" tranzample set, 10 Crystal Keys and other rewards!
3. As part of the "Unbridled Fun" Seasonal Adventure, players can also earn a special currency called “Fair Cards” from the Seasonal Adventure rewards. You can exchange these with class mentors for weapon tranzamples.

To unlock rewards within the "Unbridled Fun" Season, heroes need to earn special progression points called “Questles”. Read more to learn how to get them!  

Daily Activities (refreshes at 02:00 CET)

[h3]Quest: "Rat Affairs" by Baxter:[/h3]

·    Every day, participate in 4 activities: "Catch a Crock If You Can!", "Leave That Gloom Behind!", “I’ll Hunt You Down!” and "No Place for Shut-in Syndrome!"

·    Earn Progress Points (Questles) and the Crown Prince (can be earned once per day per character).

[h3]Pet Trade with Charlotte's Ashkalot:[/h3]

·    Trade 7 Crown Princes for 1 Emperor;

·    Trade 10 Crown Princes for 1 Rat Princess;

·    Unlimited trade of 1 Crown Prince for Progress Points (Questles) in the Seasonal Adventure.

[h3]Heavy Compliments quest by Mask’s Ashkalot[/h3]

·    Search various locations for the Sky Fair chests and open them for gifts and Questles.
[h3]
Quest: "A Good Piñata Should be Big" by Reezie's Ashkalot:[/h3]

·    On the Sky Fair, a huge piñata with tons of health will appear periodically! Just hit it once to get a chest full of goodies. There’s no limit to the number of times you can destroy it per day, but you’ll only earn Questles for it once per day!    



P.S. If you have any questions, Baxter, Mask’s Ashkalot, Reezie's Ashkalot and Charlotte’s Ashkalot are waiting for you at the Fair to help you navigate through the event!

notes.title: 🔥 Zeebo - from concept to the game!
notes.notes:
Today we would like to share with you some concept arts of Zeebo - a real menace to adventure-seekers in Royal Quest!

But what was Zeebo's journey from concept art to becoming a game character? 

Royal Quest's team regularly comes up with new content, as you know. Game designers and artists meet to share their thoughts, sketch and record the results of endless brainstorm sessions, so that they can come back to them when the time is ripe. 

And so the idea for a new boss was hovering in the air. Yet another meeting, another round of fierce debate. Our creative team was discussing the monster's appearance, sharing concepts and making drafts, while a cheerful toothy mimic was looking at them from the whiteboard.... Before long, it all came together!

Zeebo was added to the game on April 9, 2024. He's a true master of mimicry: Zeebo replicates other bosses' attacks and changes elements right during combat. He is also a sort of “test of the pen” - the first boss created by the renewed Royal Quest team. 

We are already working on more and more bosses, but it's a story for another time!

notes.title: Urgent information
notes.notes:
Dear Friends!
The upcoming game release on the scheduled release date has been jeopardized.
Today we received a request from the service of Steam, which checks games before release. Their request concerned the possibility of making in-game payments in Royal Quest (one of the necessary requirements for the release). This feature is available in the game and has already been checked by Steam employees, but for some reason additional data was required. And according to Steam rules, until the Steam platform receives all the requested information, the release on the platform is blocked.

It would appear that this is not a big deal. We have the data confirming the ability to accept and process payments in the game via Steam; we have already sent it in response to the request we received today. But the Steam team will be able to review this data on Monday at the earliest - within the framework of the working schedule, which implies working only on weekdays. 

The situation is aggravated by the time zone difference. We received the request today - when it was already Saturday, it was Friday evening in the Steam team office. If we get a positive answer on Monday (Steam team's local time), we will have Monday-Tuesday night.

In the morning we had a team discussion of all possible scenarios of the situation. The conclusions are as follows:
1.	[b]The most optimistic option[/b]. On Monday morning our data is reviewed by the Steam team; they make sure that all the data is correct; the release on October 22 is allowed again. Our plans do not change: in the late evening of 21.10.24 we inform you that the release will take place on time; we hold the release on 22.10.24.
2.	[b]Less optimistic option[/b]. On Monday afternoon our data starts to be studied by Steam team, they ask clarifying questions; gradually they make sure that all data is correct; they allow the release, but we have no time to hold it on October 22. In this case, we set the nearest date and inform you about it; the release is moved to 23.10.24 or 24.10.24.
3.	[b]Pessimistic option[/b]. Our request is being studied by Steam team not since Monday. The official position of Steam platform: the answer can be given within 3-5 working days. In this case, we inform you about the situation and together we wait for the request to be approved. Once the request is approved, we set a release date for the nearest weekday and inform you about it.

Now from the raw facts to the personal: we are very unhappy with the situation that has arisen, for which there was no obvious precondition, but even more upset for you. We are well aware of the expectations and engagement many people have for Royal Quest. We know that some players have been taking time off for the release on Steam and have been putting together and reorganizing guilds. So, we will be working hard to keep the release on track or push it back as little as possible. 

We have already changed the release date from October 1 to October 22, realizing that the game still has a lot to prepare for the launch on Steam. But (!) more than two weeks ago the game was sent to the Steam platform team for pre-release testing, and we responded to all their requests in a timely manner, time after time confirming that all the platform requirements were met. It will be the same now, only time and human factor are against us.
